prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. depth.jpg, segmentation.jpg and pose.jpg are the same 5 frames rendered as a monocular depth map (brighter = nearer to the camera wearer), an instance segmentation map (coloured masks with class labels), and a body/hand skeleton map (yellow = body, magenta = hands) on black. Look at all four images. For EACH of the three maps, describe the spatial understanding that map supports, using the RGB strip for context: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Say what each map shows that is hard to see in the RGB alone, and where the map looks unreliable. Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"depth": "...", "segmentation": "...", "pose": "..."} with 3-5 sentences each.

descriptions.depth: The depth map shows an outdoor gravel clearing receding from a bright ground plane right below the camera wearer toward dark background cliffs (>50 m away) and a distant white camper/trailer on the right (~25–30 m away), with a pickup truck with an open tailgate in the left-center foreground and two standing people just to its right. As the camera wearer walks forward across frames 1 to 5, the truck bed and people brighten significantly as their distance decreases from roughly 6–8 m in frame 1 to about 1.5–2.5 m in frame 5, where the open tailgate and the nearer person in orange pants (about 1.5–2 m away) come nearly within arm's reach of the wearer while the second person in plaid stands about 1 m further back (~2.5–3 m away) beside the truck bed. The person in orange pants initially walks away facing the truck and partially occluding the person in plaid behind them in frames 1–2, before turning left in frames 3–5 as the separation between the two people and the truck becomes clearly stratified by brightness, with the green backpack on the ground sitting within arm's reach below both people and the truck's right flank. Compared to RGB alone, the depth map clearly isolates the foreground silhouettes of the two people, the protruding open tailgate, and the bags on the ground on the far left (frames 1–2) from the similarly textured desert hillside. However, the map becomes unreliable in frame 4 when the camera wearer's cap brim and raised right hand/fingers enter the top of the frame within a few centimetres (0.05–0.2 m) of the lens, creating a massive pure-white saturation region that compresses the dynamic range of the rest of the scene into dark, compressed grey tones.
descriptions.segmentation: The instance segmentation map isolates discrete foreground entities against an unlabelled black background, identifying the pickup truck on the left, the two standing people just to its right (roughly 1.5–2 m apart from each other by frame 5, at ~1.5–3 m from the wearer), a green backpack on the ground between the truck's right rear wheel and the people's feet, and a distant vehicle on the far right (~25–30 m away). Across frames 1 to 5, the masks expand and shift toward the edges as the camera wearer approaches from ~6–8 m to ~1.5–2.5 m, showing the person in pink mask (orange pants) initially occluding the person in brown mask (plaid shirt) in frames 1–2 before separating to the right in frames 3–5, while the green backpack remains within arm's reach of both people's legs and the truck bed. In frame 4, the camera wearer's own cap and hand occlude the upper half of the field of view (and a partial blue mask labelled 'person' and 'truck' appears on the upper left of frame 5), while the distant vehicle on the right is partially clipped by the frame boundary. This map makes it easier than RGB alone to distinguish the boundary between the two overlapping people in frames 2–3 and to spot small distant vehicles behind the truck gap, though it omits most of the clutter inside the truck bed except for a single 'suitcase' or 'backpack' mask. It is notably unreliable in its class labels and mask fragmentation, misclassifying the distant RV/camper as a 'train' across frames 1–5, mislabelling the boulders on the left in frame 2 and the cap/hand occlusion in frame 5 as 'person', and flickering the pickup truck label between 'truck' and 'car' while leaving large holes in the truck bed mask where gear is piled.
descriptions.pose: The pose map is completely blank (black) across frames 1 through 4 and detects only a single yellow body skeleton in frame 5 for the nearer person on the right (~1.5–2 m from the camera wearer), when they are large and unoccluded in the foreground. In frame 5, this skeleton shows the person standing upright to the right of the truck and in front/right of the second person, with torso and head angled toward the left of the frame (facing toward the truck and the other person rather than looking directly at the camera wearer) and both elbows bent with wrists raised near the mouth and face within their own arm's reach, while their lower legs are cut off at the bottom edge of the frame. The map fails to detect the second person standing ~1 m behind and to the left (~2.5–3 m from the wearer, holding a green bag at waist level), any of the people in frames 1–4 when they are 3–8 m away or facing away, or the camera wearer's own hand at the top of frame 4. While the frame 5 skeleton makes the nearer person's dual-arm raised posture and leftward body orientation immediately explicit without visual clutter from clothing or background rocks, the map is highly unreliable overall due to missing all distant/mid-range poses in frames 1–4, missing the second person entirely in frame 5, and omitting all magenta hand skeletons despite both people actively holding items in their hands.
